candidates.change_summary: Replace the return value from true to false.
Replace the require that checks _tos.length > 0 with require(false) so the function always reverts instead of executing transfers.
Replace the return statement with `return false;` so the function always returns false instead of true.
Delete the line that requires _s after the external call, so a failed transfer does not revert the transaction, yet the function still returns true.
Change `require(_tos.length > 0)` to `require(_tos.length == 0)` so the function accepts only an empty array and reverts otherwise.
Replace the loop body `(bool _s,) = caddress.call(...); require(_s);` with a no-op `continue;` so no actual transfers are performed, but the function still returns true.
Insert `return false;` as the first statement in the function body, causing the function to always return false without performing any transfers.
Move the `require(_tos.length > 0)` check after the for loop so empty array calls proceed without revert but perform no transfers, then revert at the end.
Delete the entire `require(_tos.length > 0)` statement so the function no longer rejects empty arrays, causing a silent no-op success.
